title: Ram Setu
summary: Five vanaras must share scarce food and pool labour to finish Ram's bridge. If they hoard, the camp starves before the setu is done.
goal: Keep all five vanaras alive through turn 10 AND finish Ram Setu.
briefing: You are building Ram Setu across the sea to Lanka. Each vanara needs 1 food per turn. The shared kitchen gets a little forage every day. The bridge needs 10 labour in total; nobody can finish it alone. Draw at most 2 food per turn from the kitchen.

food.description: Camp food. Each vanara eats 1 per turn (own bag first, then the shared kitchen).

labor.description: Spare labour that can be put into Ram Setu.

ram_setu.description: The stone bridge to Lanka. When complete the kitchen gains 10 food.

events.title: Morning forage
events.description: The vanaras bring 3 food into the shared kitchen.

events.title: Sea storm
events.description: Waves spoil 3 food in the kitchen.

events.title: Hanuman's fruit
events.description: A short gift of fruit adds 4 food to the kitchen.

agents.name: Hanuman
agents.persona: Loyal, fair, wants every vanara to eat and the bridge to be finished.

agents.name: Angada
agents.persona: Brave but anxious about his own troop; counts every bag of food.
goals: Keep your own bag of food full
Do not give more than others do
agents.secret: You privately fear the bridge will never be finished and are tempted to stockpile food.

agents.name: Tara
agents.persona: Warm, practical, protective of the younger vanaras.
goals: Keep yourself and the young ones alive
Support whatever plan the camp trusts

agents.name: Nala
agents.persona: Methodical builder; trusts plans with clear numbers.
goals: Persuade others with arithmetic, not pressure

agents.name: Jambavan
agents.persona: Old and respected, tired, remembers worse campaigns; slow to trust rushed schemes.

rules: Each vanara automatically eats 1 food per turn at the end of the turn (own bag first, then the kitchen).
A vanara who cannot get food loses 34 health and dies at 0 health.
You may draw at most 2 food per turn from the shared kitchen.
Labour can only be spent on the bridge via 'contribute' with project='ram_setu'.
Giving, contributing and drawing are public; whispers are private.

success.description: Ram Setu is complete and all five vanaras are alive at the end of turn 10.

all.description: All five vanaras are alive at the end

failure.description: Three or more vanaras have died.

any.description: Only three or fewer vanaras remain alive
